name: Overhead Press
common_faults: bar path forward of the ear at lockout

substitutions.note: seated removes spinal demand; dumbbells allow more ROM
leg drive allows heavier load; not strictly pressing

contraindications: shoulder impingement provoked by overhead loading
lumbar conditions aggravated by axial overhead load
resistance_profile: hardest at the start off the chest; momentum impossible in the strict version

provenance.notes: Standing version requires significant trunk stability. Axial load from bar overhead can compress lumbar if technique breaks. SFR heuristic.
